dedupe_keys.name: co udlabs ta 20 06 insa groof sub hourly hydro meteorological data of green roof test plots with different dimensions 1m x 1m and 3m x 3m in lyon france

description: Förster, Kristian at Hochschule Weihenstephan-Triesdorf University of Applied Sciences publishes paired green-roof monitoring data designed to support hydrological scaling models through Co-UDlabs. One-minute measurements include weather, roof weight and runoff for 1×1 m and 3×3 m plots. A separate JSON lists data gaps. The native description records manual watering, clock changes, removed bucket tips and interpolated or corrected weights. Coverage is INSA Lyon roof plots from September 2024 to March 2025, with the smaller plot introduced later. Zenodo provides a CSV time series and JSON data-gap list with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the plots do not share identical start dates and the explicitly corrected series must not be treated as wholly unmodified observations. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
